sentence: She have bought a new book and a apple from the shop.
original_text: She go to school evry day and she don't likes to study English. Yesterday she go to the market with her friends but they was very late. She have bought a new book and a apple from the shop. Her brother are waiting for her at home and he have went to the park. They is playing cricket when she arrived there. I has also went with them but I am not knowing how to play. Everyone were happy and the childrens was enjoying the game. One boy runned very fast and he fall down. His friends helps him but he don't wanted any help. After that we goes back to home because it was getting dark. On the way, she said that she have saw a beautiful bird near the road. I told her that birds is usually afraid of people. She smiled and say that she will come again tomorrow. It was a very nice day but we forgetted to take some photos.

sentence: While we was waiting, another student come into the library and starts talking very loudly.
original_text: Yesterday, my classmates and I goes to the college library to prepare for our final exam. We was planning to study for three hours, but one of my friends forgetted to bring his notes. He don't knew where he kept them, so he calls his brother and ask him to search the room. While we was waiting, another student come into the library and starts talking very loudly. The librarian tell him to keep quiet because several students was trying to concentrate. After some time, my friend finded his notes inside a old bag. We started studying, but I couldn't understood some of the difficult topics. My friend explain them to me and give me a useful example. Later, we takes a short break and went to the cafeteria. I ordered a sandwich and an orange juice, but there wasn't many tables available. We finally found a empty table near the window and sat there. One of my friends said that he have never seen such a crowded cafeteria before. After lunch, we returned to the library and continued our preparation. By the evening, everyone were tired, but we was satisfied because we had completed most of our revision. Before leaving, we promised that we will meet again tomorrow and finish the remaining chapters.
